core_obligations: Statement (lines 7361-7372): if a : U -> X is an fppf hypercovering of the algebraic space X by the simplicial algebraic space U, then K -> Ra_*(a^{-1}K) is an isomorphism for all K in D^+(X_etale).

Setup (proof lines 7374-7382): consider the diagram of Lemma lemma-compare-simplicial-objects-fppf-etale; Rh_{n,*}h_n^{-1} = id by the More on Cohomology of Spaces lemma, hence Rh_*h^{-1} = id on D^+(U_etale) by the simplicial direct-image lemma.

Four-equality chain (lines 7384-7403): Ra_*(a^{-1}K) = Ra_*Rh_*h^{-1}a^{-1}K = Rh_{-1,*}Ra_{fppf,*}a_{fppf}^{-1}(h_{-1})^{-1}K (commutativity of the comparison diagram) = Rh_{-1,*}(h_{-1})^{-1}K (descent lemma; U an fppf hypercovering) = K.
proof_roadmap: Move through the comparison diagram to the fppf topology.
Collapse by fppf-hypercovering descent and conclude.
difficulty_reason: Cohomological-descent lemma (statement 7361-7372, proof 7374-7403): fppf hypercoverings give descent for D^+ - explicit four-equality chain with each equality justified by a named tool (levelwise identity, comparison-diagram commutativity, fppf hypercovering descent, componentwise identity); complete as stated. H2.
